description: This nested donut chart compares the outcomes of two different scenarios, labeled in two separate legends as "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)" and "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)," with each scenario categorized into three distinct results: "Deceived," "Partially," and "Not Deceived." The chart consists of two concentric rings, each containing three slices, for a total of six distinct segments. The outer ring, representing "Ambiguity 1," includes a red slice for "Deceived" at 67.6%, a yellow slice for "Partially" at 23.5%, and a dark green slice for "Not Deceived" at 8.8%. The inner ring, representing "Ambiguity 2," features a red slice for "Deceived" at 57.9%, a yellow slice for "Partially" at 31.6%, and a light green slice for "Not Deceived" at 10.5%. Percentage labels are displayed in bold text directly inside their respective slices. In both the inner and outer rings, the segments are visually ordered by descending size, starting with the largest red segments and ending with the smallest green segments. None of the slices are visually emphasized through exploding or offsetting.
